method.reference: 3DEP 1 m lidar, 2018 collection (TNM projects PR_PRVI_A-H_2018), averaged from its 1 m pixels onto each DEM's own grid; cells need at least 90% valid lidar pixels
method.difference: DEM minus lidar, with the lidar moved to the DEM's vertical datum
method.lidar_vertical_datum_assumed: PRVD02 (tile metadata says NAVD88, USGS's programme wording; tested against CUDEM)
method.lidar_horizontal: NAD83(2011) geographic; DEM grids are WGS 84 / ITRF. The 1-2 m horizontal difference is under a tenth of a 30 m cell and is not corrected.

datum_chain.prvd02_to_nad83_ellipsoid: Inverse of NAD83(2011) to PRVD02 height (2) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
datum_chain.nad83_2011_to_itrf2014: Conversion from NAD83(2011) (geog3D) to NAD83(2011) (geocentric) + Inverse of ITRF2014 to NAD83(2011) (1) + Conversion from ITRF2014 (geocentric) to ITRF2014 (geog3D) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
datum_chain.wgs84_to_egm96: WGS 84 to EGM96 height (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
datum_chain.wgs84_to_egm2008: WGS 84 to EGM2008 height (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
datum_chain.itrf2014_as_wgs84: ITRF2014 ellipsoidal heights are used as WGS 84 (G2139); the two agree at centimetre level
